topic.articleTitle: How to Clean Painted Walls Without Damaging the Finish
topic.searchIntent: Informational guidance for homeowners who want to remove dust, fingerprints, scuffs, and light residue from painted walls without dulling or damaging the finish
topic.targetAudience: Homeowners, renters, and household decision-makers looking for safe, practical wall-cleaning guidance
topic.seoValue: This evergreen topic answers a common home-care question that is distinct from the existing move-in, move-out, and Airbnb turnover articles. It can attract early-stage informational traffic while creating relevant paths to deep and recurring cleaning services.

contentStrategy: Create a cautious, finish-aware wall-cleaning guide that helps readers identify the type of mark, test a cleaning method, work in the correct order, and recognize when additional scrubbing could cause damage. Emphasize practical decision-making rather than universal product claims, and connect wall care naturally to broader deep-cleaning and recurring-maintenance needs.
